title: hardcoded column index 11 in sender_msg_id rejection
description: row_to_message() uses FromSqlConversionFailure(11, ...) to report NULL sender_msg_id. Column index 11 is correct today but is not verified at compile time — if the SELECT list changes, the index drifts silently. Scenario: future maintainer adds/reorders columns → reported column index in the error is wrong, debugging becomes harder. Consequence: silent wrong metadata in the error, not a crash — but it erodes the value of the structured error type.
